items.title: Apple is reportedly cutting hundreds of jobs from Siri, Vision Pro teams
items.content: Apple has admitted that some roles are being impacted as it shifts its focus away from certain initiatives.

items.title: ChatGPT can now send texts for you with new Apple Messages plug-in
items.content: Ever wanted someone else to do your texting for you? ChatGPT is being offered up as an automated text scribe via a new Apple Messages integration.

items.title: Apple overhauls its EU App Store fees, loosens rules for alternative app stores

items.title: Why Apple’s camera-equipped AirPods may not be the ‘pervert pods’ consumers fear
items.content: Apple’s leaked camera-equipped AirPods might avoid the privacy pitfalls of other AI wearables by preventing users from recording photos and videos.

items.title: Hyperscalers might regret embracing natural gas if new forecast proves correct
items.content: Natural gas prices could triple in some parts of the U.S., which could saddle hyperscalers with massive bills to power their AI data centers.

items.title: Microsoft kills off unsuccessful AI features while merging its separate Copilot apps
items.content: Microsoft is simplifying Copilot by combining its consumer and business apps, and dropping AI-generated podcasts, Group Chats, Deep Research, and its Mico character.

items.title: After Microsoft threatened legal action, a security researcher publishes a new Windows zero-day bug
items.content: This is the latest zero-day released by security researcher Nightmare Eclipse, despite Microsoft publicly threatening to take legal action against them.

items.title: Microsoft is openly competing with OpenAI, Anthropic more than ever
items.content: Microsoft pitched its own homegrown AI models, harnesses, and even a Mythos competitor on Wednesday, telling Wall Street it plans for continued growth.

items.title: Canada Is Retaliating Against Trump’s Tariffs. Will Others Follow?
items.content: Prime Minister Mark Carney’s decision to retaliate against U.S. tariffs has drawn praise from China, and exposed a rift in the Trump administration.

items.title: Research Firm’s Founder Explains $6 Million Payment to Fired Forbes Editor

items.title: Washington Post Ordered to Rehire Fired Columnist Karen Attiah
items.content: An arbitrator ordered the newspaper to reinstate Karen Attiah, who was fired after posting about “white men who espouse hatred and violence” following Charlie Kirk’s killing.

items.title: Oil Prices Fall Ahead of U.S. Vow to Intensify Economic War Against Iran
items.content: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is expected to announce an escalation of sanctions aimed at further isolating Iranian trade.
